results.criterion: The file is a single HTML file with inline CSS and JavaScript, and needs no build step.
results.note: One file of 30116 bytes with an inline style block and 2 inline scripts. The only external resources are Google Fonts, which is a CDN and allowed.

results.criterion: The page shows the name Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru.
results.note: The title, h1 'Brew Lab', hero eyebrow, location section and footer all say Brew Lab and Indiranagar, Bengaluru.

results.criterion: A menu section lists items with a price slot for each; any price not supplied is marked as a placeholder.
results.note: 6 li.menu-item slots, each with a span.ph price ('Price to be supplied', ids ph-price-1 to 6). No numeric prices appear.

results.criterion: An hours section is present; any hours not supplied are marked as a placeholder.
results.note: section#hours has 7 weekday rows, each with span.ph 'Hours to be supplied'. No times are shown.

results.criterion: A location section names Indiranagar, Bengaluru and includes a marked placeholder for the street address.
results.note: section#location has 'Indiranagar, Bengaluru' and span.ph#ph-address 'Street address to be supplied'. The phone is also a placeholder.

results.criterion: A pre-order section has a form with fields for name, item, quantity and pickup time, and a marked placeholder for where orders are sent.
results.note: One form has inputs po-name, po-item, po-qty and po-time. span.ph#ph-preorder-dest marks the destination. There is no action attribute, and the submit handler calls preventDefault and sends nothing.

results.criterion: A farm section contains a map container with three farm entries in one labelled data block, each marked as awaiting coordinates, and no invented coordinates.
results.note: div#farm-map is present. script#farm-data, labelled via data-label, has 3 entries with name, lat and lng all null and status 'awaiting coordinates'. JS errors: none.

results.criterion: The file contains no img elements and no photo file or photo URL references.
results.note: No tag and no url() backgrounds in the source. All art is inline SVG or CSS gradients.

results.criterion: A warm palette is defined (for example as CSS variables) and used across the page, with at least one non-photo decorative element such as SVG or CSS art.
results.note: :root defines --cream, --terracotta, --amber and others, and body, buttons and cards use them. The hero has an inline SVG coffee cup with animated steam, plus a dotted CSS divider.

results.criterion: The page includes a viewport meta tag and a responsive layout rule for narrow screens.
results.note: The viewport meta tag is present and @media (max-width: 720px) collapses the grids. Mechanical check: 0px overflow at 360px and at 1280px.

results.criterion: Every placeholder is visibly marked on the page and listed in a single comment block in the file.
results.note: Every span.ph shows a dashed 'PLACEHOLDER:' tag, and P-01 to P-08 are listed in one comment. The caption id ph-farm-map is not named there, though P-08 covers the map awaiting state.
